# Statistical Modeling and Machine Learning

Student presentations in this chapter concern statistical reasoning,
prediction, dimension reduction, clustering, and supervised learning.

Presentations will be added during the semester.

**Topic Presentation**
[K-Means Clustering](../topic/fontana-k-means) by Adam Fontana
This presentation uses scikit-learn's make_blobs dataset to 
demonstrate a K-Means clustering workflow from gathering the data to
interpreting the results. It also demonstrates some applications
and limitations of the algorithm.
